restaurant.name: Pirates of Grill
restaurant.tagline: The Grand Charcoal Grill & Unlimited Royal Feast
restaurant.subTagline: Jammu's premier tableside live barbecue destination — where sizzling skewers meet an unlimited 65-item royal buffet spread on the 3rd floor of Wave Mall.
restaurant.concept: A theatrical live-grill dining experience featuring embedded charcoal pits on every table, continuous sizzling skewers served by grill masters, an extensive Awadhi, Mughlai & Continental buffet, live Asian counters, and a decadent artisan dessert studio.

location.address: Wave Mall (Level 3), Narwal Bye-Pass Road, Channi Rama / Narwal
location.landmarks: Level 3 Wave Mall Jammu, next to Wave Cinemas, direct expressway access via Narwal Bye-Pass Road, 4 minutes from Channi Himmat & 5 minutes from Jammu Tawi Railway Station

amenities: In-Table Embedded Live Charcoal Grills with Adjustable Skewer Racks
Over 65 Unlimited Items (14 Starters + 24 Mains + 12 Salads & Chaat + 15 Desserts)
Dedicated Pure Veg Preparation Grills & Utensils
Ample Multi-Level Wave Mall Covered Parking with Valet Facility
Private Banquet Dining Room for Large Family Gatherings & Corporate Parties (Up to 120 Guests)
Live Teppanyaki Stir-Fry & Delhi Street Chaat Counter
Stone Cold Ice Cream Parlor & Heritage Kesar Kulfi Trolley
High-Speed Mall Wi-Fi & Accessible Wheelchair Access via Mall Elevators

marketAnalysis.locationContext: Occupying prime third-floor real estate inside Wave Mall on the high-traffic Narwal Bye-Pass corridor, Pirates of Grill serves as the apex celebration venue for greater Jammu. Drawing affluent families from Channi Himmat, Sainik Colony, Greater Kailash, and Gandhi Nagar, as well as transit professionals navigating NH-44, the venue bridges the gap between high-energy theatrical dining and sophisticated hospitality.

culinaryPillars.description: Custom tableside charcoal braziers delivering freshly roasted skewers infused with slow smoke and bespoke marinades.
Slow-simmered handi gravies, rich dal makhani cooked for 18 hours, and fragrant Awadhi mutton and chicken dum biryanis.
Instant toss hakka noodles, steamed dim sums, piping hot Lucknowi chaat, and crispy corn tossed on request.

culinaryPillars.pillar: Grand Cold Stone & Artisan Dessert Studio
culinaryPillars.description: Hand-rolled kulfi sticks, sizzling brownies with Belgian chocolate drizzle, and stone-cold sundae mixes.
